propositions: Contributors cannot manually re-review a change with a real finding-BLOCK on the current revision; only infrastructure vetoes (coverage-gap sub-reasons) and escalated/terminal -1s are contributor-retrigger-eligible.

A Gerrit comment containing the token 'recheck-review' must trigger a fresh review by fetching the bot's current-revision LLM-Review vote message tag from Gerrit's authoritative record and parsing it to determine eligibility, never trusting the comment text itself.
The retrigger mechanism must reset the shared per-revision retry budget (from ticket 0347) before enqueueing a forced re-review, harmonizing the manual escape hatch with bounded automatic recovery.
Reply comments must contain only a message body with no labels key, preventing any vote write and preserving the fail-closed review pipeline.

Bot-authored comments and comments lacking the 'recheck-review' token must be silent no-ops; the tag parser must classify all three production tag shapes including merge-change suffixes and treat unparseable tags as eligible (fail-open to a fresh fail-closed review).
